newsitem.title: NORWAY: Ship traffic at Kaarstoe oil port hits new record.
newsitem.headline: Ship traffic at Kaarstoe oil port hits new record.

text.p: Ship traffic at the Kaarstoe oil terminal north of Stavanger on the west coast of Norway rose by more than 10 percent in 1996 to a new record of 398 calls from 361 a year earlier, operator Den norske stats oljeselskap AS said on Thursday.
Deliveries from the plant also reached new peaks at 3.1 million tonnes of condensate and naphtha compared with 2.6 million tonnes in 1995.
Liquefied petroleum gas deliveries reached three million tonnes in the 12-month period from 2.8 million tonnes a year ago.
Statoil said the increases primarily reflected higher production from the Sleipner fields in the North Sea.
